sources.entry: Baserow | No-code database and Airtable alternative

summary.one_liner: Baserow is an open-source, no-code platform for building databases, applications, automations, dashboards and AI agents, positioned as an Airtable alternative that can be self-hosted.
summary.what_it_does: Baserow provides a spreadsheet-like database interface for organizing structured data, with an option to build applications and portals published on your own domain. It includes automations for repetitive workflows and dashboards for visualizing data. A built-in AI assistant named Kuma can create databases and workflows from natural language. The project is described as API-first and headless, built with Django, Vue.js and PostgreSQL, and can be run via Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, or several hosted platforms.
use_cases: organizing team data in a spreadsheet-style database
publishing custom apps or portals on own domain
how_to_run: For development: git clone the repository, then cd baserow
notable: Open-core: non-premium and non-enterprise features under the MIT License
Built-in AI assistant (Kuma) that builds databases and workflows from natural language
API-first and headless, with an OpenAPI schema
Multiple install targets including Helm, Heroku, Render, AWS, Railway and Elestio
caveats: Premium and enterprise features are not under the MIT License
README notes merged and closed merge requests were not imported during the move from GitLab to GitHub
Self-hosting setup for development requires the just task runner and Docker Compose
